title: RealReview
tagline:
First on-chain feedback platform that 
let user earn rewards
description:
User are not rewarded directly (Average Per hour less then $1.70 ) :
The the users filling the feedback are not properly incentivised for their efforts. These feedback are used to inprove a product and service or used towards a marketting campaign.

Middleman consuming a huge share.
The firms requesting a review outsource the task to the middle firms, which blocks the incentives reach the end reviewer, and it is goes to the middleman.

No direct ownership of data to the requesting firm. 
The requesting firm should only be the owner of the feedback data acquired. but many middleman survey firms are not lible for the security of the data.
how_its_made: We ran into couple of hurdle related the signing of transactions on FE. We solved those problems by searching on the web for similar problems and got ideas to solve it.
